title: The Drowned Chapel
objective: Recover the chapel's silver from the flooded nave and get back out alive. Leave by the porch when you are ready.

rooms.name: Chapel Porch
rooms.description: A stone porch at the edge of a marsh. The chapel's door hangs open, and dark water laps over its sill.

features.name: Notice Board
features.description: A weathered board nailed beside the door.
features.discovery: A rain-smeared notice from the parish: the sexton drowned in the spring flood, and the chapel plate was never recovered.

rooms.name: Flooded Nave
rooms.description: Knee-deep black water fills the nave between rows of rotting pews. Something moves slowly near the altar.

features.name: Sunken Altar
features.description: A stone altar, its top just clear of the water.
features.discovery: Wedged behind the altar is the chapel's reliquary of chased silver, and a moss agate has fallen from its lid into the silt.

items.name: Silver Reliquary
items.description: A small casket of chased silver, its lid set with tiny pearls.

items.name: Moss Agate
items.description: A milky stone threaded with green, like weed under ice.

rooms.name: Vestry
rooms.description: A small room above the waterline, its cupboards swollen shut with damp.

features.name: Alms Cupboard
features.description: A tall cupboard with a slot cut in its door.
features.discovery: Inside are the parish's alms in a leather bag, a stoppered vial of red liquid, and a ring of keys with a chrysoprase fob.

items.name: Parish Alms
items.description: A leather bag of gold and silver pieces.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Chrysoprase Fob
items.description: A translucent apple-green stone on a ring of rusted keys.

passages.description: Through the open door and down into the water.
Three worn steps climb out of the water to a side door.

opponents.name: Drowned Sexton
opponents.description: The drowned sexton rises from the water by the altar, weed in its hair, and wades towards you.

endings.title: Out with the chapel silver
endings.text: You wade back out to the porch with the chapel's silver safe in your pack.

endings.title: Out of the chapel
endings.text: You wade back out to the porch with nothing but wet boots.

endings.title: Drowned in the chapel
endings.text: You go under the black water. Your adventuring ends here.
